title: A Dashboard That Cannot Lie
tagline: Observability that lies is worse than none, and it will lie about itself first.

story.problem: A public engineering console reported four things that were not true, and none of them raised an error. It counted zero specialists during a five-way fan-out because it was built on `subagent.called`, an event eve 0.24.4 documents on the parent's durable stream and never emits. It displayed 73% for reply understanding, a score belonging to a classifier that had been reverted hours earlier. And it counted every failed search as a healthy tool call, because `web_search` reports failure as `{status: "search_failed"}` and returns cleanly, so nothing counting exceptions could see it. And it published 7/12, 58% for research quality beside a cookbook citing 52/53 for the same command, because the research eval graded a run whose specialists were still searching: twelve checks where a settled run produces thirty-seven to fifty-three. Every 'Open trace in LangSmith' button 404'd for the same class of reason: the link was built from the OTel trace id rather than the run id LangSmith derives from a span id, and nothing ever fetched it.
story.solution: Count delegations at `actions.requested`, where a subagent call is genuinely visible, and discover child lanes from the trace tree each specialist writes for itself. Move the success/refusal/failure taxonomy into agent/lib/actions.ts as one shared reading, ordered to match eve's protocol — `status` before `error`, because eve attaches an error to a rejection as well as to a failure. Subtract refused calls through `toolRuns` before any surface reports work done. Stamp every eval summary with the model it ran on, and refuse to score one whose specialists never settled: `incomplete` carries the reason and every surface renders that run unscored. Verify a LangSmith run exists before returning its URL, and render `null` as a disabled caption rather than a dead link.
story.outcome: Lanes populate live and the research eval stopped triple-running one fan-out. `npm run test:outcomes` reads 22 status literals back out of 26 tool sources and fails on any the taxonomy does not classify; `npm run test:fold` drives the real fold with events in eve's delivered shape. Two follow-up fixes each failed one level below the defect before that pairing existed. An unsettled research run now reads as unscored on `/observe` and prints NOT SCORED in `npm run report`, so the panel and the cookbook no longer quote different numbers for the same command. The structural fix for the stale score — the console flagging a summary whose model no longer matches the live routing — is recommended in the decision record and is not built.

prerequisites: KV_REST_API_URL and KV_REST_API_TOKEN (or the UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_* pair) — the trace store
LANGSMITH_API_KEY and LANGSMITH_TRACING=true — the exporter's export() is a no-op without the second
Node 24 (package.json `engines`) and `npm install` at the repository root
Recipe 02 (Delegation): a single-agent run has no tree, and the tree is where the lies live
One run that actually fans out — a panel with one lane cannot disagree with itself

quickstart.clone: git clone https://github.com/jaredwerba/vendor-scout.git && cd vendor-scout && npm install
quickstart.configure: Create .env.local with KV_REST_API_URL and KV_REST_API_TOKEN for the trace store, plus LANGSMITH_API_KEY and LANGSMITH_TRACING=true for span export. Neither guard command below needs them.
quickstart.run: npm run test:outcomes && npm run test:fold

endpoints.description: Every root session, newest first — the session picker on /observe. Summaries are redacted at write time, so the route needs no gate.
One whole agent tree: the root plus every specialist, each with its recorded event log, plus a LangSmith URL that is null unless the run was verified to exist.
Every eval summary the scripts have uploaded, each stamped with the model it ran on.
